Title: Azure Cloud Shell now supports additional storage regions

Body.Content:
Azure Cloud Shell now supports additional storage regions.  When using a secondary storage region, your compute still occurs in an existing Cloud Shell region, but your data at rest is held in the selected secondary region. Customers with data sovereignty requirements, or with existing storage in a secondary region, should take advantage of this new capability.

Learn more
